content:
Hi, on the lean 4 game server, whenever I try to download my data, it gives a file with just the word undefined in it. This seems to have started Sunday, possibly before. I can't seem to fix it and it seems to be happening on Chrome, and firefox. I've attached the file I recieve when I attempt to download my data.
lean4game-undefined-3_24_2026.json
Meanwhile, you can sinply open browser console, look into local storage and copy your game data from there. That button is just a wrapper for this.

Jon Eugster said:

Meanwhile, you can sinply open browser console, look into local storage and copy your game data from there. That button is just a wrapper for this.

I show a workaround here:

https://leanprover.zulipchat.com/#narrow/channel/113489-new-members/topic/Issue.20with.20downloading.20game.20state.20in.20Set.20Theory.20Game/with/581697657
Thanks both of you for the report. I've checked that this is fixed on the latest main Branch. Unfortunately, we're a bit behind with deployment as we lost support for Windows users

Jon Eugster said:

Unfortunately, we're a bit behind with deployment as we lost support for Windows users

Hey Jon :man_raising_hand:

Just curious, what does "we lost support for Windows users" mean?

The server stopped working for Windows end users after a larger, necessary update and fixing it involves another large, slow refactor removing some old dependencies which should probably have been removed a long time ago. So we leave the old version running until that's addressed.
